verdict.rationale: Docs show the API replicates most ChatGPT-UI capabilities (text generation styled like ChatGPT, web/file search, image generation, voice, structured outputs, function calling, agents, fine-tuning) via SDKs/CLI, suggesting broad functional overlap between API and UI use cases (gpt-docs-1,4,7,11,24,25,27,28,30). However there is no evidence addressing parity for ChatGPT-specific UI-only features (custom GPTs, canvas, memory management, plugins marketplace) or an explicit statement that API achieves 1:1 parity with the UI, and community evidence focuses on coding-agent comparisons rather than API/UI parity itself. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of parity for UI-exclusive features (canvas, custom GPTs, memory settings) and independent confirmation that nothing is UI-only.
